# Red Wood Farm

> Garden family restaurant and party lawn on outer Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana, Punjab. Family restaurant first, party lawn second. North Indian, tandoor and Indo-Chinese food, 187 priced dishes, open every day.

## Key facts
- Name: Red Wood Farm
- Address: 676, VPO Daad, Pakhowal Road, Opp. Cerajot Tiles, near Omaxe Flats, Ludhiana, Punjab 142022
- Phone and bookings: 096467 13555 (https://wa.me/919646713555)
- Hours: 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM, every day
- Service: dine-in on a garden lawn with fairy lights, takeaway, Wi-Fi
- Accessibility: no wheelchair access
- Menu: 187 dishes (131 veg), prices in Indian rupees, inclusive of GST; many mains in half and full portions
- Parties: birthday parties, kitty parties, family functions and corporate lunches on the lawn, booked by message
- Not published (ask us): guest capacity, per-plate and package prices
- Google rating: 4.2 from 72 reviews (as of 17 Nov 2026)
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=8737420667065992361

We don't offer private dining or candle set-ups. Family anniversaries for bigger groups can be planned on the lawn by message.

Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road has a garden lawn with long wooden tables by day and a full menu from 10:00 AM. Budget depends mostly on your guest count, so fix that first.

Red Wood Farm hosts birthdays on its garden lawn on outer Pakhowal Road, open 10 AM to 11 PM daily. Party prices depend on your menu, so ask at 096467 13555.

These are general planning figures. For ordering at Red Wood Farm, ask us at 096467 13555.

## Food & menu guides
- [Biryani and Rice on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana: Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/biryani-and-rice/): In short: Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana serves Veg Biryani at ₹325 and Non-Veg Biryani at ₹375, GST included. The Rice section has eight dishes in all, from Steamed Rice at ₹180, and the Curd & Raita section has seven raitas and curds from ₹125 to ₹200 to eat with them.
- [Butter Chicken and Chicken Curries at Red Wood Farm, Ludhiana](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/chicken-curries/): In short: Butter Chicken at Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana costs ₹415 for a Half and ₹695 for a Full, GST included. It is one of 15 chicken curries on our menu, which also has two house dishes: Farm to Table Special Chicken (Half ₹415, Full ₹695) and Atta Chicken, cooked sealed inside wheat-flour dough, at ₹925.
- [Dal Makhani in Ludhiana: Dal Makhni at Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/dal-makhani/): In short: Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana serves Dal Makhni at ₹275 for one Full portion, GST included. Pair it with Butter Naan (₹45), Laccha Paratha (₹45) or Jeera Rice (₹230). We are open every day from 10 AM to 11 PM, and you can order it for takeaway at 096467 13555.
- [Food Children Like at Red Wood Farm, Ludhiana](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/kids-favourites/): Plenty of what children like is on the Red Wood Farm main menu: French Fries at ₹195, Hakka Noodles at ₹255, Paneer Tikka at ₹375, Butter Naan at ₹45 and ice cream from ₹50 a scoop. Families order from the regular menu and share, and every price includes GST.
- [How Much to Order for a Group: Half and Full Portions Explained](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/group-ordering-guide/): At Red Wood Farm, 24 main-course dishes come in Half and Full; everything else has one price. As general guidance, order one starter or platter and one main for every three or four people, about two breads each, and add rice and raita for larger tables. Takeaway group orders go by phone or message.
- [How to Read Our Menu: Veg Marks, GST, Half and Full](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/menu-marks-and-gst/): On the Red Wood Farm menu, a green square with a dot marks veg and a reddish-brown square with a triangle marks non-veg. Every price is in rupees and already includes GST. Half and Full columns appear only on some main courses, and ice creams are priced per scoop.
- [Indo-Chinese Food in Ludhiana at Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/indo-chinese/): In short: Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana serves Indo-Chinese dishes beside its North Indian menu. Hakka Noodles cost ₹255, Manchurian Dry ₹275, Manchow Soup ₹155 and Chilli Paneer ₹375, and chicken versions such as Chicken Manchurian start at ₹355. All prices include GST.
- [Naan, Roti and Paratha: Every Bread at Red Wood Farm, Ludhiana](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/indian-breads/): In short: Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana lists 14 breads, from Tandoori Roti and Tawa Roti at ₹20 to Cheese Naan at ₹80, with Butter Naan at ₹45 and Garlic Naan at ₹55. Four stuffed parathas with butter, from ₹50 to ₹60, sit in the Sides section. All prices include GST.
- [Paneer Dishes at Red Wood Farm, Ludhiana, With Every Price](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/paneer-dishes/): In short: Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana has 16 dishes with paneer in the name. Paneer Tikka and Paneer Achari Tikka cost ₹375 each, twelve paneer gravies run from ₹295 to ₹395 for a Full, and six of them come as a Half from ₹225. Prices include GST.
- [Paneer Jalebi with Rabri and Other Desserts at Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/desserts/): Red Wood Farm lists eight desserts from ₹35 to ₹75 and five ice creams priced per scoop from ₹50. Paneer Jalebi with Rabri is ₹75. Gajrela and Malpua Rabri are seasonal, and every price includes GST.
- [Tandoori food on Pakhowal Road: a guide to our tandoor menu](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/tandoor-guide/): In short: Red Wood Farm on outer Pakhowal Road serves Tandoori Chicken at ₹375, with eight veg and nine non-veg dishes in its Tandoori section. The Tandoori Veg Platter is ₹525 and the Tandoori Non-Veg platter is ₹725. Breads start at ₹20 for a Tandoori Roti, and all prices include GST.
- [Vegetarian food on Pakhowal Road: 131 veg dishes at Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/vegetarian-guide/): In short: Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana serves both veg and non-veg food, and 131 of its 187 menu dishes are marked veg with a green mark. Vegetarians can order from every section, including soups, tandoori, soya champ, paneer curries, breads, rice and desserts. One dessert, Ice Cream with Brownie, is marked non-veg until we confirm whether it contains egg.
- [What to Order at Red Wood Farm on Your First Visit](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/food/first-visit-what-to-order/): On a first visit to Red Wood Farm, start with a soup or a starter, share one tandoor plate, then order Dal Makhni (₹275), one curry, a round of breads and a dessert. Non-veg tables should try the house Farm to Table Special Chicken (Half ₹415, Full ₹695).

## The garden & evenings outdoors
- [A family outing near Ludhiana with kids: an afternoon at Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/family-outing-with-kids/): In short: for a family outing near Ludhiana, spend an afternoon or evening at Red Wood Farm, a garden restaurant at Daad on outer Pakhowal Road, about 6.8 km from Sarabha Nagar. Children get open grass to move around on and the menu runs from fries and noodles to tandoor and curries. We are open 10 AM to 11 PM every day, with no wheelchair access.
- [An evening on the lawn at Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/an-evening-on-the-lawn/): In short: an evening at Red Wood Farm on outer Pakhowal Road means dinner on an open garden lawn after a walk through a tunnel of warm white fairy lights. You can sit on the grass, under lit palms or in a lounge corner under string lights, and order from the tandoor and the curry menu. We are open every day until 11 PM, and tables are booked by message at 096467 13555.
- [Date night in Ludhiana: a garden dinner for two under the lights](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/date-night-ludhiana/): In short: for a date night in Ludhiana that feels outdoors, book an evening table on Red Wood Farm's garden lawn on outer Pakhowal Road, walk the fairy-light tunnel, and order from a full North Indian and Indo-Chinese menu. A dinner for two can come to about ₹890. It is a family restaurant, so tables are open, not private cabins.
- [Farm to table in Ludhiana: what the term means at Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/farm-to-table/): In short: Red Wood Farm is a garden family restaurant on outer Pakhowal Road, and Farm to Table Special Chicken (₹415 half, ₹695 full) is the name of our house signature dish. We do not claim to grow our own produce or to buy from named farms, because that is not confirmed. If sourcing matters to you, ask us about the dish you plan to order.
- [Garden Restaurants in Punjab: What They Offer and How to Choose One](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/garden-restaurants-punjab/): A garden restaurant in Punjab is a place to eat outdoors on a lawn or among trees, usually serving North Indian and tandoor food, often with space for family functions. Choose one by checking the menu prices, evening lighting, drive time, accessibility and how booking works. Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana is one example.
- [Open-air dining in Ludhiana: a garden lawn on Pakhowal Road](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/open-air-dining-ludhiana/): In short: Red Wood Farm is an open-air garden restaurant on outer Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana, open every day from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Tables sit on a grass lawn, under palm trees and on low lounge seating beneath string lights, and you walk in through a fairy-light tunnel. Menu prices run from ₹20 to ₹925 with GST included.
- [Sunday family lunch in Ludhiana on a garden lawn](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/sunday-family-lunch/): In short: Red Wood Farm opens at 10 AM every day, Sunday included, and serves lunch on a daytime garden lawn on outer Pakhowal Road. Many curries come in Half and Full portions, which makes it easy to share across a big table. Large families should book with a message at 096467 13555 with the date, time and number of guests.
- [The Fairy-Light Tunnel at Red Wood Farm, Ludhiana](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/fairy-light-tunnel/): Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road has a walk-through tunnel of warm white fairy lights over a red carpet, with green uplights in the trees around it. It looks best after dark, and it's the part of the garden guests photograph most. We're open daily until 11 PM.
- [Weekend plans on the outskirts of Ludhiana: Pakhowal Road and Daad](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/weekend-plans-near-ludhiana/): In short: for an easy weekend on the outskirts of Ludhiana, drive out along Pakhowal Road to Daad, about 6.5 to 7 km from Dugri, Sarabha Nagar and Model Town. Gurdwara Bhai Bala Sahib Ji is about 1.6 km from us on OpenStreetMap. Then spend the afternoon or evening at Red Wood Farm, a garden restaurant open 10 AM to 11 PM daily.
- [Winter evenings on the lawn: dinner outdoors in Ludhiana](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/garden/winter-evenings-on-the-lawn/): In short: Red Wood Farm on outer Pakhowal Road serves dinner on its garden lawn every evening until 11 PM, winter included. Dress warm for December and January, start with a hot soup from ₹145 and order from the tandoor. Message us before you leave to ask what is set up on the lawn that night.

## Getting here
- [Dugri to Daad: Driving to Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/visit/from-dugri/): Red Wood Farm is about 6.5 km from Dugri by road. OSRM sends you along Phase 1 Road and Jawadi Road, which meets outer Pakhowal Road for the last 2.8 km to Daad, in about 12 minutes with no traffic. Look for Cerajot Tiles; we are opposite.
- [Ferozepur Road to Pakhowal Road: Reaching Red Wood Farm from Bharat Nagar Chowk](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/visit/from-ferozepur-road/): From Bharat Nagar Chowk on Ferozepur Road, Red Wood Farm is about 9.5 km by road, around 14 minutes with no traffic according to OSRM. You follow Ferozepur Road for about 1.5 km, cross to Pakhowal Road, and stay on it out of the city to Daad. We are opposite Cerajot Tiles.
- [Ludhiana Railway Station to Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/visit/from-railway-station/): Red Wood Farm is about 10.7 km from Ludhiana Railway Station by road. The route follows Ferozepur Road, then Pakhowal Road out of the city towards Daad, and OSRM estimates about 16 minutes with no traffic. Take a cab or auto booked on an app, or drive, and allow extra time at peak hours.
- [Model Town to Pakhowal Road: Directions to Red Wood Farm](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/visit/from-model-town/): Red Wood Farm is about 6.9 km from Model Town by road. The OSRM route takes Model Town Road and Krishna Mandir Road onto Pakhowal Road, then follows it out of the city to Daad, in about 11 minutes with no traffic. We are opposite Cerajot Tiles, near Omaxe Flats.
- [Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana: Where It Runs and How Far Things Are](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/visit/pakhowal-road-guide/): Pakhowal Road is a Ludhiana road that runs from the city out towards Daad village. Routes from Ferozepur Road, Model Town, Sarabha Nagar and the railway station all join it, and OpenStreetMap labels its outer stretch Jodhan - Ludhiana Road. Red Wood Farm sits on that outer stretch, opposite Cerajot Tiles.
- [Places Near Red Wood Farm, Daad and Pakhowal Road](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/visit/places-near-red-wood-farm/): According to OpenStreetMap, the places nearest Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road include Daad village (0.8 km), Palam Vihaar (0.9 km), Thakarwal village (1.1 km) and Gurdwara Bhai Bala Sahib Ji (1.6 km). These are straight-line distances from our map pin, so the road trip is a little longer.
- [Sarabha Nagar to Red Wood Farm, Pakhowal Road near Daad](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/visit/from-sarabha-nagar/): Red Wood Farm is about 6.8 km from Sarabha Nagar by road. OSRM routes you along a short stretch OpenStreetMap labels Rotary Club, then Pakhowal Road out to Daad, in about 11 minutes with no traffic. We are opposite Cerajot Tiles, near Omaxe Flats.

## Guides
- [Birthday Party Budget Planning: A Method That Holds Up](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/guides/birthday-party-budget/): A birthday party budget is your confirmed headcount multiplied by the venue's per-plate quote, plus decor, cake, return gifts and a buffer for late changes. Get every quote in writing with the same questions answered. Red Wood Farm shares per-plate prices, and our à la carte prices are public on the menu page.
- [How to choose a party venue in Ludhiana](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/guides/how-to-choose-a-party-venue-ludhiana/): In short: fix your guest count and budget first, then compare Ludhiana party venues on indoor or outdoor space, who cooks the food, the time slot, travel time for guests and access for older or disabled relatives. Get the menu, prices and slot in writing before you pay an advance. Red Wood Farm on Pakhowal Road is used here as an honest example, including that it has no wheelchair access.
- [How to Host a Kitty Party: The Host's Job, Step by Step](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/guides/kitty-party-hosting-guide/): To host a kitty party, book the venue for your turn, send the invitation on the group's chat with a reply-by date, collect every member's contribution and record it, hand the month's kitty to the member whose turn it is, and keep the food and the games on a simple timetable. The host manages two things: the money and the clock.
- [Outdoor vs Indoor Party Venues: An Honest Comparison for Ludhiana](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/guides/outdoor-vs-indoor-party-venues/): An outdoor lawn gives you space, fresh air and lit-up photos after dark, while an indoor hall protects you from heat, rain and cold and is easier for elders. In Ludhiana the month decides most of it: October to March suits a lawn, and May, June and the monsoon push many parties indoors.
- [Punjabi Winter Food: Saag, Gajrela, Pinni and What to Order](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/guides/punjabi-winter-food/): Punjabi winter food follows the cold-season harvest: mustard greens for saag, red carrots for gajrela, fresh peas, fenugreek and cauliflower, plus ghee-rich sweets like pinni. At Red Wood Farm the seasonal Saag is ₹275 and Gajrela, 100 g is ₹75; makki di roti and pinni are not on our menu.
- [What Is Famous to Eat in Ludhiana: A Visitor's Food Guide](https://bhapag.github.io/redwood-farm/guides/ludhiana-food-guide/): Ludhiana eats classic Punjabi food: dal makhani, tandoori chicken and paneer tikka, saag with makki di roti in winter, chole, stuffed parathas with butter, and lassi. At Red Wood Farm you can order most of the curries, tandoor dishes and parathas at listed prices, while lassi, kulcha, bhature and makki di roti are not on our menu.
